1.1: N, Z, Q, I, R standard sets; R = Q ∪ I.
1.3: Null set = { } ya φ; {φ} null set nahi hai.
Subset: A ⊆ B. Non-empty set ke kam se kam 2 subsets (φ aur khud).
Equal ⇒ equivalent, par equivalent ⇒ equal nahi.
1.5: A ∪ B: dono ke elements. A ∩ B: common elements.
A - B: A ke wo elements jo B mein nahi.
1.6: De Morgan: (A ∪ B)' = A' ∩ B', (A ∩ B)' = A' ∪ B'.
A ∪ A' = U, A ∩ A' = φ.
1.7: n(A × B) = n(A) × n(B); A × B ≠ B × A.
2.1: Proposition = true ya false wala declarative sentence.
2.2: ~p: NOT. p ∧ q: dono true. p ∨ q: koi ek true.
p → q sirf p=T, q=F par false. p ↔ q: same value par true.
2.4: Tautology = hamesha true. Contradiction = hamesha false.
2.6: A ≡ B: A ↔ B tautology (same truth table).
3.1: Row, column, zero, square, diagonal, scalar, identity.
3.2: Upper: diagonal ke neeche 0. Lower: diagonal ke upar 0.
Transpose: rows ↔ columns. Symmetric: A = Aᵀ.
3.3: kA: har element ko k se multiply.
3.4: AB possible: cols(A) = rows(B). Order: rows(A) × cols(B).
3.7: 2 × 2: swap diagonal, baaki ka sign badlo.
4.1: A × B = sab ordered pairs (x, y), jahan x ∈ A aur y ∈ B.
A se B tak relation = A × B ka subset.
4.2: Domain = pehle elements ka set; Range = dusre elements ka set.
4.3: Arrow diagram: har pair ka ek arrow (a → b).
Matrix: rows = A, columns = B; entry 1 matlab pair R mein hai.
4.4: Set A par relation = A × A ka subset.
|A| = n ho to 2^(n²) alag relations possible.
4.5: Reflexive: har (a, a) R mein. Irreflexive: koi (a, a) R mein nahi.
a = b reflexive hai; a < b irreflexive hai.
4.6: Anti-symmetric: (a, b) aur (b, a) dono ∈ R ⇒ a = b.
4.7: Transitive: (a, b) aur (b, c) ∈ R ⇒ (a, c) ∈ R.
4.8: x + y divisible by 2 ek equivalence relation ka example hai.
4.9: x ≤ y POSET hai; x > y nahi (reflexive nahi).
4.10: Function: A ke har element ka B mein exactly ek image.
Domain = A, co-domain = B; do alag inputs ka same output ho sakta hai.
4.11: (g ∘ f)(x) = g(f(x)): pehle f lagao, phir g.
g ∘ f aur f ∘ g generally same nahi hote.
